'''Kenneth Leon Nordtvedt Jr.''' (April 16, 1939 – October 9, 2025) was an American physicist. He specialized in research for [[List of government space agencies|space agencies]], including [[NASA]], and promoted the use of [[Lunar Laser Ranging experiments]] to test theories of [[gravity]]. The [[Nordtvedt effect]], a hypothetical gravitational effect, is named after him.

== Life ==
Nordtvedt graduated from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] (MIT) in 1960 and obtained a PhD from [[Stanford University]] in 1964. He was a junior fellow in the [[Harvard Society of Fellows]] from 1963 to 1965. Soon after witnessing the Sputnik spacecraft{{Which|date=November 2025}} cross the Boston sky in fall of 1957, he became a part-time student employee for the Mars Probe project at the [[Draper Laboratory|MIT Instrumentation Lab]], and in early 1960s was staff physicist at the same laboratory's project to develop the [[Apollo program]]'s navigation and guidance system. 

He was a board member and scientific advisor overseeing the joint NASA-ESA [[STEP (satellite)|Space Test of Equivalence Principle]] mission. In 1986 he was appointed by then President [[Ronald Reagan]] to the [[National Science Board]].  He had support from [[NASA]] and the [[National Science Foundation]] for much of his research, as well as being a [[Sloan Fellow]]. His research was the subject of a ''[[Wall Street Journal]]'' article featured on the front page.<ref>[http://calspace.ucsd.edu/spacegrant/Five_Years/SGrsrch%7Cpg14.html The National Space Grant College and Fellowship Program]</ref>{{Failed verification|date=March 2026}}

Nordtvedt was elected to three terms in the [[Montana state legislature]] for a six-year period from 1979 to 1984, and there he wrote one of the first inflation indexing reforms of income tax law in the nation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tax issues drew physicist back into Politics |url=https://www.bozemandailychronicle.com/news/wildlife/tax-issues-drew-physicist-back-into-politics/article_0f0b0b4d-d55f-51c0-9575-f28e375a2f92.html}}</ref> He served briefly in 1989 as Director of the Montana Department of Revenue.

He died on October 9, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kenneth Nordtvedt Obituary (1939 - 2025) - Bozeman, MT - Bozeman Daily Chronicle |url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/bozemandailychronicle/name/kenneth-nordtvedt-obituary?id=59851773 |access-date=2025-10-23 |website=Legacy.com}}</ref>

== Works ==

=== Gravitation ===
{{Main|Nordtvedt effect}}
In 1968 Nordtvedt calculated how and to what degree the [[Equivalence principle|gravitational-to-inertial mass ratio]] of gravitationally compact bodies—bodies with significant gravitational binding energy—will generally differ from one in gravity theories other than [[general relativity]], and he then showed how [[Lunar Laser Ranging experiments|lunar laser ranging]] data could be used to measure that key ratio to significant precision for the Earth. This phenomenon is now called the [[Nordtvedt effect]]. This effect would violate the [[equivalence principle]], and no evidence of this effect has been found. This effect is of special interest in alternative [[Scalar–tensor theory|scalar–tensor theories]] of gravity, like [[Brans–Dicke theory]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Poisson |first=Eric |url=https://www.google.fr/books/edition/Gravity/lWBzAwAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=brans+dicke+nordtvedt+effect&pg=PA756&printsec=frontcover |title=Gravity: Newtonian, Post-Newtonian, Relativistic |last2=Will |first2=Clifford M. |date=2014-05-29 |publisher=Cambridge University Press |isbn=978-1-139-95239-2 |language=en}}</ref>

He showed in 1988 that [[general relativity]]'s [[Gravitoelectromagnetism|gravitomagnetism]] between Earth and Moon, as those bodies orbit the Sun, was essential to fitting the synodic month and half synodic month range signals from lunar laser ranging.<ref name="Nordtvedt">{{cite journal |last1=Nordtvedt |first1=Ken |date=November 1988 |title=Existence of the gravitomagnetic interaction |journal=International Journal of Theoretical Physics |volume=27 |issue=11 |pages=1395–1404 |bibcode=1988IJTP...27.1395N |doi=10.1007/BF00671317 |s2cid=120546056}}</ref>

=== Genetic genealogy ===
Nordtvedt performed research into genetic [[haplogroups]], particularly the [[Human Y-chromosome DNA haplogroup|Y-chromosome DNA]] group [[Haplogroup I (Y-DNA)|I]], to which he belonged.<ref>[http://rjgg.molgen.org/index.php/RJGGRE/article/view/16/12  Кен Нордведт. Свыше 20,000 лет истории гаплогруппы I1b1 (P37.2+) Вадим Веренич The Russian Journal of Genetic Genealogy (Русская версия), Vol 1, No 1 (2009).] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110727091811/http://rjgg.molgen.org/index.php/RJGGRE/article/view/16/12 |date=2011-07-27 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.jogg.info/42/files/nordtvedt.pdf |title=More Realistic TMRCA Calculations Ken Nordtvedt Journal of Genetic Genealogy, Volume 4, Number 2, Fall, 2008, pp. 96–103. |access-date=February 22, 2011 |archive-date=April 12, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160412070423/http://www.jogg.info/42/files/nordtvedt.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>
